title: It Takes Two
provenance: community consensus (AppleGamingWiki / r-macgaming / MacPlay), unverified by Highball. Reported by david0ha (highball-db#361, 2026-10-06), Apple M4 Pro, macOS 26.3, Highball 0.10.10, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r21, the environment in DXMT mode, rated 5 of 5 after 109 minutes; see also highball-db#216. alex-jke (highball-db#455, 2026-10-11), Apple M1 Pro with 16 GB, macOS 15.7.4, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r26, DXMT with msync, rated 5 of 5 after playing it start to finish in online co-op through the Friend's Pass with a friend on a Windows PC, about 57 to 63 fps at 1080p on the default preset.
notes: Works on DXMT. A player finished the whole game in online co-op through the Friend's Pass with a friend on a Windows PC, on an M1 Pro with 16 GB and macOS 15, at about 57 to 63 fps at 1080p on the default preset.
